subject: Renewal QBR & Roadmap — consolidated 60/30 proposal
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Roberts <kai.roberts@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal QBR — single-block ask

Hi Neha,

We’re approaching our renewal window and want to lock in a QBR that covers both the renewal commercials and the product roadmap/demo. Ideally we’d keep it compact (about 90 minutes) because our execs are bandwidth-constrained.

Quick context: Kai (cc’d) is the technical lead and will want a short deep-dive on latency/cost optimizations, while I’ll focus on pricing and SLA commitments. Two asks: (1) can Redwood propose a consolidated agenda that keeps exec-level updates to 30 minutes and a combined roadmap + technical demo for the remaining time? (2) provide 2-3 time windows next week that accommodate PST morning / EST afternoon.

We can share a one-page list of stakeholders after we pick a slot.

Thanks — Alice

Attachments: none

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal QBR — single-block ask

Alice — thanks for the clarity. We can absolutely do a compact, high-signal session. Proposal below:

- 0:00–0:30 (Exec brief): Renewal terms recap, adoption highlights, SLA ask (Neha + Marissa)
- 0:30–1:10 (Roadmap & demo): Product roadmap with a 20-min hands-on demo focused on throughput/latency wins (Vivek + Priyom)
- 1:10–1:30 (Action/next steps): Mutual action plan, procurement timeline, and DocuSign link for the renewal quote (Neha)

We’ll prepare a 1-page mutual_action_plan.xlsx and a short PDF agenda (attached). Can you confirm whether the execs prefer 60 or 90 minutes? We can run a 60-min condensed option (20/30/10) if exec time is tight.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2025-08-26 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2025-08-27 11:00–12:30
- Thu 2025-08-28 08:00–09:30

If none work, tell us two preferred slots and we will adapt. I’ve looped in Priyom (renewal owner), Marissa (CS lead), and Vivek (technical demo).

Best,
Neha

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Kai Roberts <kai.roberts@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T07:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal QBR — single-block ask

Thanks Neha — Wed 2025-08-27 11:00 PST looks best for the engineering folks. A couple technical asks so Priyom/Vivek can plan:
- Can the demo include a quick comparison of response time at 256-token vs 1024-token workloads?
- Would you be able to share a sample anonymized payload we can provide in advance (small file) so we can pre-validate the end-to-end?

Also Kai: if we need to split (exec + deep-dive), we can do back-to-back blocks but prefer a single contiguous meeting.

— Kai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kai Roberts <kai.roberts@lumenhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal QBR — single-block ask

Kai — great, we’ll scope the demo around those token lengths. Quick ops notes:
- Please send one anonymized sample payload to redwood-sandbox@redwood.com by EOD Monday (2025-08-25). We’ll load it into a disposable test plan so the demo reproduces your profile.
- We’ll prepare two short slides comparing unit cost estimates for the 256 vs 1024 scenarios and a micro-run of end-to-end latency under your baseline concurrency (please confirm expected concurrency).

Neha / Marissa — we’ll also draft the procurement timeline section in the mutual_action_plan to reflect a mid-September renewal target and include a DocuSign placeholder link.

Priyom

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Roberts <kai.roberts@lumenhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal QBR — single-block ask

Thanks — Wed 2025-08-27 11:00–12:30 PST confirmed. Execs want the 90-minute slot.

Action items from our side:
- I’ll send a sanitized sample payload to redwood-sandbox@redwood.com by Monday EOD.
- I’ll share a one-pager with the stakeholder list and procurement approvers by Tuesday.

Looking forward to the agenda PDF and MAP. If you can include a short recording waiver note (for internal replay), that’d help our compliance team.

Best,
Alice
